content:
joel (eng): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: quotas and rate limiting — collecting short clarifying Qs here. leadership: @maris, @dmitri, @leah.
maris (product): thanks! keep them short and we'll consolidate answers and actions.
tess (support): customer reported mismatch: Console shows monthly token quota X but API returns 429 before month end. any known causes?
leah (finance): two likely causes: 1) monthly quota is a billing allocation, but there's also an RPS cap; if sustained traffic hits RPS caps you see 429s even with remaining monthly units. 2) If they're on a trial or promotional credits, there are per-minute safeguards.
dmitri (ceo): high level: monthly quotas measure spend; rate limits protect the service. they complement each other.
joel (eng): is RPS enforced per-key or per-org? partner said they have multiple keys and still hit caps.
maris (product): enforced per API key by default. for dedicated customers or enterprise partners we can stitch keys under a contract-level allowance — but you need an enabled billing grouping.
tess (support): another quick one: are free trial credits visible in the billing exports? customer wants to reconcile invoices.
leah (finance): trial credits appear as separate line items in the billing export CSV under "credits_used" and "promo_credits". invoices reflect net charge after credits.
joel (eng): about credits and expiry: if credits are granted on day 0 and customer is inactive for 6 months, do credits expire automatically? what is the exact window?
leah (finance): promo/trial credits expire 180 days after grant unless converted via a paid plan. enterprise grant schedules may vary and are stated in the contract. we'll add exact dates to the credits UI.
maris (product): question on fallback routing: if a request routes to a cheaper quantized model due to capacity, which quota is consumed? same route or fallback model route?
joel (eng): related: does Console show that fallback path? it'd help debugging.
maris (product): current behavior: usage is charged to the actual serving route that handled the request (the fallback). the Console shows the model used in the request details but we don't yet have an aggregated fallback rollup view. filing feature request.
infra-bot: incident note: short-term RPS policing enforced 14:07 UTC for shared-hosted pool 0 min window.
tess (support): customer also asked: can we temporarily waive RPS caps during migrations?
dmitri (ceo): we can approve one-off migration allowances but require a written request 48h in advance and an operational contact. for high-risk migrations we recommend a Dedicated trial.
joel (eng): small SDK behavior: clients sometimes mis-handle the X-RateLimit-Reset header format. any guidance?
maris (product): we had a header bug last week where local timezone leaked; fixed and rolling. best practice: treat the header as advisory; rely on 429 + Retry-After. we'll add notes to SDK docs.
tess (support): can support grant temporary credits to unblock customers?
leah (finance): support can request one-time small credit grants up to $500 via finance ticket; larger amounts need approvals and a paper trail.
maris (product): for the team: pasteable reply for support: `Rate limits (RPS) protect live serving and are enforced per-key; monthly quotas track allotted units/credits and do not stop short bursts unless RPS caps are hit; credits offset charges but expire per their grant terms. For sustained production throughput, we recommend Dedicated or a quota increase request.`
joel (eng): thanks. last: will Console show tag-based spend breakdowns soon? we'd like project-level cost visibility.
maris (product): yes 0 launch next quarter: tag-based labels + exportable usage CSV by tag.
dmitri (ceo): action items: product to track composite quota view + tagging (maris), finance to update credit expiry FAQ (leah), support to get migration request template (tess).
maris (product): I'll open the feature tickets and link here.
leah (finance): I'll update billing docs and post the FAQ PR.
tess (support): will assemble migration checklist and request template.
joel (eng): appreciate it. closing thread in 24h unless more Qs. :wave:
